# strettchcloud_image (Data Source)

Finds a single OS image by filter. At least one filter is required; filters combine with AND. Zero matches or more than one match is an error when read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up one image by slug...
data "strettchcloud_image" "by_slug" {
  image = "UBUNTU-24.04"
}

# ...or by name and version. Filters combine with AND and must match exactly one.
data "strettchcloud_image" "by_name" {
  image_name = "Ubuntu"
  version    = "24.04"
}

# List every image in the catalog.
data "strettchcloud_images" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `image` (String) Image slug, e.g. `UBUNTU-24.04`. Filter and output.
- `image_name` (String) Image name, e.g. `Ubuntu`. Filter and output.
- `version` (String) Image version, e.g. `24.04`. Filter and output.

### Read-Only

- `display_name` (String) Human-friendly image name. Output only.
